[{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Here is a comprehensive, production-ready `README.md` file for your Employee Management REST API.\n\n---\n\n# Employee Management REST API\n\nA lightweight, high-performance RESTful API built with **FastAPI** and **Pydantic** for managing employee records. This application features full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations, in-memory data storage, automatic interactive documentation, and a robust test suite.\n\n---\n\n## Features\n\n- **Full CRUD Operations**: Create, read, update, and delete employee records.\n- **Partial Updates**: Supports updating only specific fields of an employee record using `PUT` with optional fields.\n- **In-Memory Database**: Fast execution without the overhead of external database configurations (ideal for prototyping and testing).\n- **Data Validation**: Strict type-checking and validation powered by Pydantic.\n- **Auto-Generated Documentation**: Interactive Swagger UI and ReDoc documentation out of the box.\n- **Automated Tests**: Comprehensive integration tests using `pytest` and FastAPI\'s `TestClient`.\n\n---\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Framework**: [FastAPI](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/)\n- **Data Validation**: [Pydantic](https://docs.pydantic.dev/)\n- **ASGI Server**: [Uvicorn](https://www.uvicorn.org/)\n- **Testing**: [Pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) & [HTTPX](https://www.python-httpx.org/) (required for `TestClient`)\n\n---\n\n## Project Structure\n\n```text\n├── app.py          # Main application code and API endpoints\n├── test_app.py     # Integration and unit tests\n└── README.md       # Project documentation\n```\n\n---\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Python 3.8 or higher installed on your system.\n\n### Installation\n\n1. **Clone or create the project directory** and navigate into it:\n   ```bash\n   mkdir employee-api\n   cd employee-api\n   ```\n\n2. **Create a virtual environment** (recommended):\n   ```bash\n   python -m venv venv\n   source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows use: venv\\Scripts\\activate\n   ```\n\n3. **Install the required dependencies**:\n   ```bash\n   pip install fastapi uvicorn pytest httpx\n   ```\n\n---\n\n## Running the Application\n\nStart the local development server using Uvicorn:\n\n```bash\nuvicorn app:app --reload\n```\n\nThe server will start running at **`http://127.0.0.1:8000`**.\n\n### Interactive API Documentation\n\nOnce the server is running, you can access the interactive API documentation:\n\n- **Swagger UI**: [http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs](http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs) (Allows you to test endpoints directly in the browser)\n- **ReDoc**: [http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc](http://127.0.0.1:8000/redoc)\n\n---\n\n## API Endpoints Reference\n\n### 1. Create Employee\n* **URL**: `/employees/`\n* **Method**: `POST`\n* **Status Code**: `201 Created`\n* **Request Body**:\n  ```json\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Senior Dev",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Response (Success)**:\n  ```json\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Senior Dev",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Response (Error - ID Exists)**: `400 Bad Request`\n  ```json\n  {\n    "detail": "Employee ID already exists."\n  }\n  ```\n\n### 2. List All Employees\n* **URL**: `/employees/`\n* **Method**: `GET`\n* **Status Code**: `200 OK`\n* **Response**:\n  ```json\n  [\n    {\n      "id": 101,\n      "name": "Sarah Khan",\n      "role": "Senior Dev",\n      "department": "Engineering"\n    }\n  ]\n  ```\n\n### 3. Get Employee by ID\n* **URL**: `/employees/{emp_id}`\n* **Method**: `GET`\n* **Status Code**: `200 OK`\n* **Response (Success)**:\n  ```json\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Senior Dev",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Response (Error - Not Found)**: `404 Not Found`\n  ```json\n  {\n    "detail": "Employee not found."\n  }\n  ```\n\n### 4. Update Employee (Partial/Full)\n* **URL**: `/employees/{emp_id}`\n* **Method**: `PUT`\n* **Status Code**: `200 OK`\n* **Request Body** (Only include fields you want to update):\n  ```json\n  {\n    "role": "Lead Architect"\n  }\n  ```\n* **Response**:\n  ```json\n  {\n    "id": 101,\n    "name": "Sarah Khan",\n    "role": "Lead Architect",\n    "department": "Engineering"\n  }\n  ```\n\n### 5. Delete Employee\n* **URL**: `/employees/{emp_id}`\n* **Method**: `DELETE`\n* **Status Code**: `200 OK`\n* **Response**:\n  ```json\n  {\n    "message": "Employee deleted successfully",\n    "employee": {\n      "id": 101,\n      "name": "Sarah Khan",\n      "role": "Lead Architect",\n      "department": "Engineering"\n    }\n  }\n  ```\n\n---\n\n## Running Tests\n\nThe project includes an automated test suite in `test_app.py` that verifies the complete CRUD lifecycle of an employee.\n\nTo run the tests, execute the following command in your terminal:\n\n```bash\npytest test_app.py -v\n```\n\n### Example Test Output:\n```text\n============================= test session starts ==============================\nplatform linux -- Python 3.10.x, pytest-7.x.x\ncollected 1 item\n\ntest_app.py::test_full_employee_crud PASSED                              [100%]\n\n============================== 1 passed in 0.12s ===============================\n```\n\n---\n\n## License\n\nThis project is open-source and available under the [MIT License](LICENSE).', 'extras': {'signature': ''}}]
